novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement relationship: the model’s “own prior partial-compliance turns” causally produce a “downward pull on the refusal-direction projection,” distinct from user-side context dilution, together with neutralizing the corresponding history representation. Searches using “multi-turn jailbreak prior assistant response self-consistency refusal direction,” “partial compliance re-injection history-dependent safety,” and “response prefilling jailbreak refusal activation” identified Crescendo and Multi-Turn Context Jailbreak Attack as behavioral precedents, Arditi et al.’s Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction as the geometric precedent, and Prefill-level Jailbreak as evidence that imposed compliant response prefixes alter later compliance. Moving from those works to a causal decomposition of assistant-generated concessions versus user filler, measured through evolving refusal geometry and targeted specifically in conversational memory, requires a new core relationship rather than merely transferring the refusal-direction method, although the general intuition that prior compliant text encourages continued compliance is a natural extension of multi-turn and prefill attacks; this supports high but not paradigm-level novelty.
